en_title: The Elder Scrolls Doesn't Have a New Vegas-Like Spinoff Because Todd Howard Is 'Very Protective' of the Franchise, Former Dev Claims
cn_title: 前开发者谈《上古卷轴》为何没有《新维加斯》式外传
subtitle: 对系列格外保护
opus_summary: 前贝塞斯达开发者Kurt Kuhlmann认为，陶德·霍华德对《上古卷轴》格外保护，可能不愿出现类似《辐射：新维加斯》引发的局面。他还认为，《上古卷轴Online》让系列有了满足部分玩家需求的作品。

paragraphs.en: The Elder Scrolls never got a Fallout: New Vegas -like spinoff because Todd Howard is "very protective" of the IP, according to former Bethesda developer Kurt Kuhlmann.
paragraphs.cn: 前贝塞斯达开发者Kurt Kuhlmann表示，《上古卷轴》一直没有推出类似《辐射：新维加斯》的外传，是因为陶德·霍华德对这一IP「非常保护」。

paragraphs.en: Kuhlmann, who served as lead designer and senior designer at the Microsoft studio for 20 years before leaving in 2023, shared details on his experience working on the legendary fantasy RPG franchise during an interview with FRVR . Fans have spent decades wondering why The Elder Scrolls never got the same spinoff treatment as Fallout has, but he said there's a pretty specific reason why that's the case.
paragraphs.cn: Kuhlmann曾在这家隶属微软的工作室担任首席设计师和高级设计师，任职20年后于2023年离职。他在接受FRVR采访时，分享了自己参与这一经典奇幻RPG系列开发的经历。多年来，玩家一直想知道，为何《上古卷轴》不像《辐射》那样推出外传。Kuhlmann说，其中有一个相当具体的原因。

paragraphs.en: "The whole New Vegas thing did create this, at least the perception of this, 'Who makes a better Fallout game? Oh, they should just give it to Obsidian’," Kuhlmann said. "There are the Obsidian, the New Vegas people, that think obviously New Vegas is way better, Obsidian is way better at making those games, and why don’t they just get Fallout altogether?"
paragraphs.cn: Kuhlmann说：「《新维加斯》确实让人产生了这样的想法，至少给人造成了这样的印象：‘谁能做出更好的《辐射》游戏？哦，那他们就该把系列交给Obsidian。’有些支持Obsidian、喜欢《新维加斯》的人认为，《新维加斯》显然好得多，Obsidian更擅长制作这类游戏，那为什么不干脆把《辐射》整个交给他们？」

paragraphs.en: Kuhlmann isn't sure "that Todd wanted to create that situation again for The Elder Scrolls." He added, "Todd, from my time there, he is very protective of it."
paragraphs.cn: Kuhlmann不确定「陶德是否愿意让《上古卷轴》也出现同样的局面」。他补充说：「以我在那里工作时的了解，陶德对这个系列非常保护。」

paragraphs.en: The ex-Bethesda developer continued, saying he thinks ZeniMax Online Studios' The Elder Scrolls Online "did take the heat off of that" idea. The multiplayer offshoot, which launched in 2014, is quite different from the franchise's typical single-player outings, but it's still managed to carve out its own place in its history.
paragraphs.cn: Kuhlmann接着表示，他认为ZeniMax Online Studios开发的《上古卷轴Online》「确实缓解了」推出这类外传的呼声。这款多人游戏于2014年推出，与系列通常的单人作品大不相同，但仍在系列历史中占据了一席之地。

paragraphs.en: "There are a lot of people for whom The Elder Scrolls is now ESO," Kuhlmann explained. "That's their experience with it. That's what they love, and that's where they got their Elder Scrolls gaming experience, and that's probably what they want more of.
paragraphs.cn: Kuhlmann解释说：「对很多人来说，如今《上古卷轴》就是ESO。他们通过这款游戏认识了这个系列，也喜欢这款游戏。他们的《上古卷轴》游戏体验来自这里，而他们大概还想要更多这样的内容。」

paragraphs.en: "I do think that ESO was the, 'We're doing something with Elder Scrolls. There is a product for people that want it.'"
paragraphs.cn: 「我确实认为，ESO传递的信息是：‘我们正在为《上古卷轴》推出新内容。想要这类内容的人已经有游戏可玩了。’」

paragraphs.en: Kuhlmann stopped short of confirming whether Bethesda ever had formal discussions about a The Elder Scrolls spinoff. So, as the company undergoes massive changes behind the scenes , fans will have to settle for The Elder Scrolls Online while they wait for a more traditional installment with The Elder Scrolls 6 .
paragraphs.cn: Kuhlmann没有确认贝塞斯达是否曾正式讨论过推出《上古卷轴》外传。因此，在公司内部经历重大变动之际，玩家等待更传统的系列新作《上古卷轴6》时，只能先玩《上古卷轴Online》。

paragraphs.en: The Elder Scrolls 6 was announced in 2018, but in 2026, it still seems to be years away . Xbox CEO Asha Sharma recently posted about seeing a demo for the new game , saying that "the scale and grandeur are incredible." For more, you can read about what Kuhlmann had to say regarding the potential for Starfield 2 .
paragraphs.cn: 《上古卷轴6》于2018年公布，但到了2026年，距离游戏推出似乎仍有数年。XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma近日发文表示，自己看过这款新作的演示，「其规模和恢宏气势令人难以置信」。关于《星空2》是否可能推出，也可以看看Kuhlmann怎么说。
